description: Generated caller fence, extended by the organization preset in Verjson/renovate-config (#1812). Adopters' generated callers are byte-exact generator output, so Renovate must not edit them; their action pins and runner labels move in Verjson/.github's generators and reach an adopter only when it regenerates. scripts/ci-gate/renovate-generated-callers.test.py derives this path list from the generators.

packageRules.description: Generator-owned caller paths whose output carries a dependency the github-actions manager would update: release.yml (gen-changelog-caller.sh release-node, release-artifact, release-snapshot) and changelog-contract.yml (pr-gate). Other generated callers reference only Verjson/.github workflows, whose digest updates the organization preset already disables. A hand-written release.yml is fenced too; that is the cost of matching by path, because Renovate cannot match on the generated header.
